verbs.note: Ruled situation-normal under Amy's 2026-08-25 calibration: a gate is set to a command's TYPICAL instance, not its worst one (docs/issues.md). Editing a live script IS the sanctioned surface for changing one (CLAUDE.md: there is no host file to vim). verbs.about: Install every path whose embedded seed never landed — repair a kernel lagging several seeds without resetting them one at a time
verbs.note: STAYS data-critical after review. Unlike `rc edit`, this overwrites every diverged script it finds in ONE ungated invocation, and an overwritten path cannot be recovered. It is the single command on this surface that can lose the most, and its typical instance -- repairing a lagging kernel -- still carries that blast radius. `--dry-run` exists and a human should see the diff.
